lines.text: At 06:00 the guard opens the right-hand column and waits for a name that does not arrive.
The radio gives him forty-one seconds of breathing and one request to be marked present.
He writes OPEN CHANNEL where a signature should go.
Estates crosses it out because it is not a person.
He writes it again in the RETURNED column.
It answered. That is what the column is for.
Nobody authorises the correction. Nobody removes it.
